items.text: Philadelphia QB: Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clots in lungs), out for the season. Joe Milton III makes his third start Thursday; Tanner McKee (rib) limited.

Philadelphia (early week, Mon estimate): DNP - CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring, new), CB Jonathan Jones (ankle), LB Smael Mondon (ankle), OLB Arnold Ebiketie (oblique). LIMITED - RB Saquon Barkley (neck/illness, left last game), TE Dallas Goedert (shin). FULL - WR DeVonta Smith, DT Jalen Carter, OLB Jonathan Greenard. IR - LB Zack Baun, RB Tank Bigsby.

Dallas (early week, Mon estimate): DNP - TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle), G Tyler Booker (ankle), LB Dee Winters (knee), LB Jaishawn Barham (hip/groin). LIMITED - S P.J. Locke (concussion), WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle). FULL - QB Dak Prescott (left hand), CB Joey Porter Jr. IR - CB DaRon Bland, EDGE Malachi Lawrence.

adjust.reason: Philadelphia's top two corners (Mitchell, Jones) plus LB Mondon and OLB Ebiketie missed Monday's estimate with Barkley and Goedert limited, a heavier load than Dallas missing TE Ferguson, G Booker and LB Winters. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
